name: Cinemagraph
summary: A still photograph in which one small part moves in a seamless loop: hair in wind, steam from a cup, a blink. Two New York artists named it in 2011 during fashion week.

philosophy.core_thesis: The image is still, and one small motion makes the viewer look longer.
design_principles: Freeze at least 90% of the frame; let one region of 5% to 15% of the area loop.
Loop the motion for 2 to 5 seconds with a seamless join, at 24 fps or more.
Mask the moving region with a soft edge of 4px to 12px, so that the join stays invisible.
Shoot on a tripod, so that the still part has no drift of more than 1px.
Grade the frame with muted colour, a contrast of 0.9 and a grain of 2% to 4%.
Set the frame at 4:5 or 16:9 with no caption inside it; put the title below it in a 14px serif line.
Show the image at full width with 24px to 64px of margin around it.
anti_patterns: Several parts that move at once
A visible jump at the loop point
A moving camera that breaks the still part
Heavy filters and bright stickers on the frame

layout.grid_mechanics: One large frame on a 12-column grid with 24px gutters; the frame spans 8 to 12 columns.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40% to 55% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: The frame is centred or flush-left; the title and credit sit below it, flush-left.
layout.container_geometry: Frames with a 0px radius and no border; a 1px hairline under the caption.

font_pairings.note: A fine serif for the title and a neutral sans for the credit.
A stronger serif for editorial pages.

hierarchy_rules: Set the title in 28px to 40px serif at weight 300 and the credit in 12px capitals.
Keep body text at 16px sans and at most 60 characters wide.
Let the picture be the largest element on the page.

color.palette_structure: A dark, quiet ground with warm sand and one cool blue; the photograph carries the colour.
color.contrast_rules: Warm white on gallery black holds 15:1; sand and blue are for hairlines and labels.
color.surface_treatment: A flat dark field with no texture; the photograph holds the detail.
color.light_and_shadow: The light comes from the photograph; the page adds no shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A photographic print with a fine grain of 2% to 4% and soft tone.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px hairline in #3A3F3F under captions; no frame on the picture.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline glyphs of 1.5px at 20px: play, share, save.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Fashion, travel and still-life photographs with one moving part.

motion.transition_physics: The still frame shows at once; the moving region loops for 2 to 5 seconds; the page fades in over 1200ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shows the credit line in 300ms; the loop never stops.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm and curious, and looks longer at one small movement.

use_cases: product pages with one moving detail
ad banners that need calm motion
avoid_when: The audience needs fast action or a story with many beats.
The page cannot play video or animated image formats.
The photo has no still, stable base.

modifiers.how: Let the whole frame move, crop tighter and add a one-line caption.
Add a large serif title, a rule and a column of body text beside the frame.
Soften the grade with a lifted black at 8% and a pale blue gradient edge.

pack.why: A fine outline family suits a quiet page where the photograph leads.

ground.why: A cinemagraph needs a quiet field, so the page ground is a soft dark wash that leaves the photograph alone.
